cost.name: cost
cost.basis: SYNTHETIC mean of 1/32 traced cases (0 from real telemetry, 1 hand-authored); a homogeneous real set is needed for 'estimated' — see provider token usage + price telemetry (F1.x)

latency.name: latency
latency.basis: SYNTHETIC mean of 1/32 traced cases (0 from real telemetry, 1 hand-authored); a homogeneous real set is needed for 'measured' — see live request timing via OpenTelemetry (F1.x)

efficiency.name: efficiency
efficiency.basis: useful (exact) calls / total calls — penalizes redundant, extra, wrong-args calls

accuracy.name: accuracy
accuracy.basis: mean of the per-level eval scores (L1/L2/L3)

reliability.name: reliability
reliability.basis: end-to-end success rate (all applicable levels pass); cross-run flakiness deferred to F5+
